newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices make mild recovery.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices make mild recovery.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices at the AECO storage hub in Alberta recovered from Monday's sharp decline Tuesday as Alberta Energy allowed more gas to be injected into the hub as part of its maintenance.
Most deals were confirmed done in the C$0.93-0.98 per gigajoule range Tuesday, up about 10 cents from Monday's levels.
At Sumas, prices also gained about four cents to the US$0.94-0.99 per million British thermal units range.

Storage customers were curtailed to 15 percent by September 11 due to maintenance at the facility, AEC spokesman Ben Ledene said, adding nominations have recently been running about 475-550 million cubic feet per day.
Customers will be curtailed to 30 percent by September 14, and full service is expected to be restored on September 16, Ledene said.
